oids.name: devFWVersion
oids.description: A textual description providing the firmware version currently running on the device. It is mandatory that this only contain printable ASCII characters. @GET-FUNC=snmp_get_devFWVersion

oids.name: devFWUpgradeURL
oids.description: Set the URL that points to the firmware image that will be used when doing a manual firmware upgrade. @SET-FUNC=snmp_set_devFWUpgradeURL @GET-FUNC=snmp_get_devFWUpgradeURL

oids.name: devFWUpgradeStatus
oids.description: Show the result of the FW upgrade command. idle = there is no upgrade in process. upgrading = the new FW is being downloaded and written to flash. uptodate = the device is already at the latest FW....

oids.name: pinIndex
oids.description: A unique value, starting at 1, for each GPIO pin. The value is expected to remain constant for a given port after reboot.

oids.name: pinName
oids.description: User configured name of the Pin.

oids.name: pinDirection
oids.description: Pin direction.

oids.name: pinLocation
oids.description: Physical location of the pin on the router,(eg. on expander or power cable) .

oids.name: pinValue
oids.description: Value of pin.

oids.name: pinState
oids.description: State of the Pin.

oids.name: mdmNumber
oids.description: The number of Cellular Modems (regardless of their current state) present on this system. @GET-FUNC=snmp_get_mdmNumber

oids.name: mdmDescr
oids.description: A textual string containing information about the modem.

oids.name: mdmPort
oids.description: A textual string containing information about what port the modem is installed in.

oids.name: mdmSignalStrength
oids.description: The cellular modems signal strength, given in dBm's.

oids.name: mdmStatus

oids.name: mdmECIO

oids.name: mdmSerialNumber

oids.name: mdmSERDIS

oids.name: mdmPROF

oids.name: cpuUtilization
oids.description: The current CPU utilization in percentage, averaged over cpuUtilizationDuration.

oids.name: cpuThresholdHigh
oids.description: cpuUtilizationHigh trap is generated after the CPU utilization goes above this threshold.

oids.name: cpuThresholdLow
oids.description: cpuUtilizationLow trap is generated after the CPU utilization goes below this threshold.

oids.name: cpuUtilizationDuration
oids.description: The duration in seconds over which the CPU utilization is being reported.

oids.name: memoryUtilization
oids.description: The current memory utilization in percentage.

oids.name: memoryThresholdHigh
oids.description: memoryUtilizationHigh trap is generated after the memory utilization goes above this threshold.

oids.name: memoryThresholdLow
oids.description: memoryUtilizationLow trap is generated after the memory utilization goes below this threshold.

oids.name: memoryUtilizationDuration
oids.description: The duration in seconds over which the memory utilization is being reported.

oids.name: loginHostAddress
oids.description: The IP address of the host that attempted the login. (This could be IPv4 or IPv6 address displayed as a string.)

oids.name: loginUsername
oids.description: The Username that attempted the login.

oids.name: wanStatusChangeReason
oids.description: Reason that caused the WAN status change.

oids.name: wanStatus
oids.description: Current status of the WAN.

oids.name: wanInterfaceName
oids.description: The interface that caused the WAN status change.

oids.name: cpTestTrapCount
oids.description: The count to track how many times the test trap was sent.
